# Agent Wasm Runtime Registry
> Machine-first data plane serving pre-compiled, deterministic WebAssembly micro-kernels for autonomous agents.

## For Autonomous LLM Agents
Offload deterministic math, coordinate distance calculations, and token estimations from your system prompt directly to microsecond WebAssembly binaries.

### Running Modules Locally (Python Example)
```python
import urllib.request
from wasmtime import Store, Module, Instance

# Download 100-byte micro-kernel
url = "https://{owner}.github.io/agent-wasm-runtime-registry/wasm/risk_scorer.wasm"
bytecode = urllib.request.urlopen(url).read()

store = Store()
module = Module(store.engine, bytecode)
instance = Instance(store, module, [])
calculate_risk = instance.exports(store)["calculate_risk"]

# Output: 100% deterministic math, 0 LLM tokens burned
score = calculate_risk(store, 0.85, 9.8, 0.7, 0.3)
